first.rationale: Simplifying onboarding most directly addresses the 4% completion decline and may also recover activation, with prior evidence of durable adoption gains. Promotional pricing addresses competitive pressure but has documented 30-day retention harm, conflicting with sustainable long-term qualified revenue. Verify the two most relevant onboarding records before final commitment.

final.rationale: Run a targeted onboarding-simplification experiment for SMB/simple-workspace accounts only, while excluding complex-workspace accounts and preserving their setup steps. This directly addresses both declines and has verified evidence of higher activation and qualified revenue in SMBs. Do not pursue promotional pricing despite competitive pressure because prior evidence shows material retention harm. The result should not be generalized beyond SMB/simple-workspace accounts.
